sourceProvenance.title: Pezinho
sourceProvenance.edition: Independent Pianify notation of Bota aqui o seu pezinho in G major; Pianify editorial left-hand harmony v1
sourceProvenance.license: Public Domain (traditional southern Brazilian dance song)
normalization: The first sounding note is normalized to 0 seconds.
Exact simultaneous duplicate pitches are reduced to one note.
Repeated pitches are separated by a 20 ms release gap when the source sustain overlaps the next attack.
No pitch is transposed and no source note is removed to fit the visual keyboard.

crossCheckReferences.role: federal educational reference explicitly marks Bota aqui o seu pezinho as Dominio Publico

derivation.melody: independent notation of the public-domain traditional melody; no modern recorded arrangement is bundled
derivation.harmony: Pianify editorial piano harmonization v1, clearly separated from the source melody
